hint: The parentheses group two numbers together. That grouped part has to be worked out before the division.

hints.text: The parentheses group two numbers together. That grouped part has to be worked out before the division.
Subtract inside the parentheses first: $36 - 12 = 24$. What remains is the division $24 \div 4$.

explanation: Do the work inside the parentheses first: $36 - 12 = 24$.
With the parentheses finished, the expression that remains is $24 \div 4$.
Divide to finish: $24 \div 4 = 6$, so the value is $6$.

alternativeExplanations.title: A picture for it
steps: Imagine $36$ trading cards, $12$ given away, and the rest split among $4$ friends.
$24$ cards split $4$ ways gives each friend $6$ cards.
